title: add-benchmark-lab-adaptive-batching-reporting-pipeline-v80
author: Sanjay Patel
description: Motivation: extend the adaptive-batching reporting pipeline to v80 to capture new profiling baselines and representative workload runners for our latest kernel selection heuristics; Summary: adds a new reporting DAG, consolidated workload definitions, export adapters for the perf dashboard, and CI job updates to validate nightly runs; Changes include a new pipeline implementation in benchmarks/pipelines/adaptive_batching/v80, standardized workload runner wrappers, additional Prometheus metric tags for batch latency bucketing, export adapters for BigQuery and internal reporting service, and a lightweight migration script to backfill missing metrics for the last 30 days; Testing: unit tests for pipeline components, end-to-end dry-run against synthetic workloads, and a staged canary in perf-canary infra (see ci checks); Rollout plan: merge to main, enable feature flag benchlab.adaptive_batching_v80 for 10% of runs for 72h, monitor dashboards, then ramp to 100%; Checklist: [x] code + unit tests, [x] integration dry-run, [x] docs updated, [x] migration script included, [x] Linear tickets linked; Notes: this PR is backward-compatible with existing reporting consumers; no model changes.
commits: feat: add adaptive batching reporting DAG v80; test: add unit tests and synthetic workload fixtures; docs: document v80 pipeline and rollout; ci: add nightly job and canary workflow; fix: small logging and metric name fixes
review_comments: Marta Rodriguez: Please add a short explanation for the new batch latency bucketing scheme and a link to the dashboard query; Sanjay Patel: Added comment block and linked the dashboard query (dashboards/perf/adaptive-batching-v80) in docs; Evelyn Brooks: CI failed first run due to missing GCP creds in the nightly job, can we gate the BigQuery export behind a flag?; Sanjay Patel: Wrapped BigQuery export behind report.destinations.bigquery enabled flag and added a test that skips export if cred not present; Liam Chen: Approve after adding end-to-end dry-run logs to the artifact store for easier debugging; Sanjay Patel: Uploaded dry-run artifacts and updated CI to persist them on failure; Maintainer (automated): All requested changes addressed, ready to merge.
ci_checks: CI summary: 1) unit-tests (linux): pass (6m34s); 2) lint: pass; 3) integration-dry-run (canary infra): initial fail (missing creds) -> rerun: pass; 4) nightly-benchmark (pipeline lint): pass; 5) perf-canary-e2e: pass; Notes: one flaky test (tests/pipeline/test_backfill) was stabilized during review.
release_notes: Added adaptive-batching reporting pipeline v80 which introduces new batch-latency bucketing and expanded workload runners; Backfill migration included to populate recent metrics; CI adds nightly validation and canary gating for safe rollout.
